title: A Primer of the Garrote Cord
summary: Teaches a first-time student to hold the cord in both fists, form a loop and draw it taut with no qi.

title: Drill-Book of the Toggle Grip
summary: Drills the wooden toggle grip, the thumb wrap and the cross-wrist throw of the loop for students without qi.

title: Handbook of the Wire Loop
summary: Sets out how to shape, throw and release a small wire loop using only trained arm and back strength.

title: The Cord Walker's Exercises
summary: Practises the quiet approach, the corner wait and the overhead loop throw that begin every garrote attack.

title: Plain Rules of the Short Garrote
summary: Teaches leverage with hips and knees so a short cord can be drawn home by a body without qi.

title: A Qi-Fed Primer of the Garrote
summary: Introduces the first thread of circulating qi along the cord for students who have passed the Second Awakening.

title: Handbook of the Measured Breath
summary: Pairs each pull and release of the cord with the breath so the student's qi stays calm under strain.

title: Workbook of the Wound Cord
summary: Drills winding the cord about the forearm and wrists, charged with a trace of qi, for guarding and binding.

title: The Senior's Garrote Drill-Book
summary: Sets low postures, wrist locks and qi-held pulls for Senior students who already circulate qi steadily.
